exact_checks.scope: Exact finite checks; not verification of asymptotic limits or bounds.

symbolic_checks.scope: Exact identities and finite polynomial coefficients; no asymptotic claim is inferred from these checks.

numerical_diagnostics.warning: Floating-point illustrations, not interval certificates or asymptotic proof.

pdf_checks.layout_review: All 40 pages rendered; full-document contact sheets inspected, with detailed views of the principal critical theorem and the figures. Section openings adjusted to keep the principal critical statement together.

internal_mathematical_review.compact_parameter_section: Independent review checked saddle errors, complement ranges, collision truncation, powers of c, and cancellation in the logarithmic refinement. No substantive gap identified.
internal_mathematical_review.deficit_section: Independent review checked normalization, signed l1 errors, Stein estimate, both constants, global mean optimization, and positive approximation. No substantive gap identified; a cutoff convention was clarified.
internal_mathematical_review.growing_degree_section: Two independent reviews checked all parameter-dependent estimates, the forest allocation inequality, weighted complement, rotation, and the final average. No substantive gap identified.
internal_mathematical_review.qualification: AI-assisted internal mathematical review, not external peer review or proof-assistant certification.

not_certified: Effective numerical onset thresholds for the asymptotic bounds
